title: Sustainable Finance: SFDR and Greenwashing
summary: How the EU sustainable finance framework applies to funds and managers, from SFDR classification and principal adverse impacts to fund naming rules, and whether disclosures prevent greenwashing.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How the EU sustainable finance framework applies to funds and managers, from SFDR classification and principal adverse impacts to fund naming rules, and whether disclosures prevent greenwashing.
Learning Objectives: Explain SFDR entity and product disclosures and the Article 6, 8 and 9 categories
Assess sustainability claims in fund documents, names and marketing
Evaluate the SFDR review and the case for product categories
Syllabus: SFDR, the Taxonomy Regulation and sustainability preferences under MiFID II
Principal adverse impacts and pre-contractual and periodic templates
ESMA guidelines on fund names using ESG or sustainability terms
Intended Audience: Supervisors, authorisation and policy staff at national competent authorities covering funds and asset managers
Compliance, legal, risk and product staff at UCITS management companies, AIFMs, investment managers and distributors
Directors, depositary and fund administration staff who need a working map of the EU fund rulebook
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of asset management, funds or their supervision is helpful. No legal background or prior knowledge of EU law is required.
Core Reading: Directive 2009/65/EC on undertakings for collective investment in transferable securities (UCITS Directive)
Directive 2011/61/EU on Alternative Investment Fund Managers (AIFMD)
Directive (EU) 2024/927 amending the AIFMD and UCITS Directive on delegation, liquidity risk management, supervisory reporting, depositary services and loan origination (AIFMD II)
Regulation (EU) 2019/2088 on sustainability-related disclosures in the financial services sector (SFDR)
